Homemade Graham Cracker Crust Mix
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 12:27am

Ingredients




1 box graham crackers -- 32
ounce 
1 cup Granulated sugar
2 teaspoons Ground cinnamon

Preparation

1 Process 6 or 7 graham crackers at a time in a blender (or food processor fitted with the metal blade) until fine crumb stage is reached. Pour crumbs into a large bowl; repeat with remaining graham crackers. Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Pour into a conta 2 Makes about 9 c of Homemade Graham Cracker Crust Mix.
